sloka: जनकेन समादिष्टा दूताः ते क्लान्त वाहनाः ।त्रि रात्रम् उषिता मार्गे ते अयोध्याम् प्राविशन् पुरीम् ॥१-६८-१॥
transliteration: janakena samādiṣṭā dūtāḥ te klānta vāhanāḥ ।tri rātram uṣitā mārge te ayodhyām prāviśan purīm ॥1-68-1॥

translations.english: Commanded by Janaka the messengers travelled for three days, rested for three nights on the way and entered the city of Ayodhya along with their horses tired.
